With a four-stroke engine, being well maintained you will not have to worry about mechanical failures while on your boating vacation. blurb: Utah Boat and Jet Ski Rentals offers a large fleet of motorized recreational equipment including inboard v-drive wakeboard boats, jet skis, ATVs, waverunners, snowmobiles, water sports equipment, boat tours and charters, and water toy accessories. They serve the entire state of Utah's boating lakes and reservoirs and other states in the US. Rentals include boats for eleven to eighteen passengers and the newest Sea-Doo jet ski models.
